description: This PHP file defines a class extending SugarView for rendering a Google Maps marker detail map in the SuiteCRM module. It includes an HTML page with embedded JavaScript to initialize and display a Google Map centered at a configured location, including marker rendering and reverse geocoding.

classes.name: Jjwg_MarkersViewMarker_Detail_Map
classes.description: A view class for rendering a Google Map in marker detail view in the SuiteCRM module.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs an HTML page with embedded JavaScript to render a Google Map focused on marker location.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the HTML content for the marker detail map, including scripts to initialize Google Maps with marker based on module data.
